# Contributing

## Development Setup

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

## Pull Request Expectations

- Keep changes scoped and reviewable.
- Update docs when behavior or configuration changes.
- Add or update tests for behavior changes.
- Preserve CLI compatibility unless intentionally changed and documented.

## Architecture Boundaries

Follow repository boundaries documented in `AGENTS.md`:

- Orchestration in `src/application/`
- Recursive policy in `src/domain/`
- CLI and I/O in `src/cli/`
- Interfaces in `src/ports/`
- Implementations in `src/adapters/`

## Quality Checklist

Before submitting:

```bash
npm run typecheck
npm test
```

If your change touches config behavior, also validate against `rlm.config.yaml` and config schema logic in `src/application/project-config.ts`.
